map.name: Attack Challenge
map.testedVersion: Selected-artifact v1.1.10 static/package conservation audit; SHA-256 927d96c9c4be301b80ebd2f5e1706d284a1ec8e92cc89e4742b9558b100a444d. Tester observations are identified through foundBy=tester; historical reports are not current proof.

bugs.title: Ranged enemies replace fatal death with an invulnerable dying-to-despawn path
bugs.problem: Marksman and Sharpshooter intercept fatal damage, enter a 4.25-second immobile/invulnerable dying state, then instant-despawn while Attack's explicit NPC defeat settlement is owned by entityDie.
bugs.expected: Every defeated gameplay enemy has clear death feedback and exactly-once kill/score/retry-survivor settlement regardless of terminal presentation.
bugs.observed: The ranged family uses fatal -> deals_damage:no -> start_dying -> movement 0 / damage disabled -> instant_despawn; CombatTracker increments npcKills and killedEntityConfigIds from entityDie.
bugs.aiAnalysis: The selected artifact exposes an alternate terminal mechanism for ranged enemies without an explicit shared settlement owner. This also matches the tester-visible abrupt stop/disappearance symptom.

relevantCode.reason: CombatTracker defeat settlement is driven by entityDie.

bugs.suggestedFix: Route every enemy terminal path through one explicit exactly-once defeat settlement owner; keep visual death presentation separate from authoritative settlement.
mustPreserve: Kill bonus and retry survivor preservation

bugs.title: Loading blackscreen can expose intermediate world frames
bugs.problem: The transition intended to hide teleport/loading uses fire-and-forget camera/input commands, so acquire and release can overlap gameplay mutation.
bugs.expected: Hidden loading is established before teleport/load and released only after destination readiness/final camera state.
bugs.observed: beginLoadingVisual repeatedly fires camera fade and movement-lock commands without awaiting an opaque state; endLoadingVisual independently fires movement enable, camera clear and fade release.
bugs.aiAnalysis: There is no authoritative acquire -> mutation/readiness -> release sequencing boundary.

relevantCode.reason: beginLoadingVisual/endLoadingVisual own fade, camera clear and input release.

bugs.suggestedFix: Use one ordered presentation owner: acquire/lock -> establish hidden state -> teleport/load -> readiness -> final camera -> release black -> release input.

bugs.title: Last-second flag capture can race timeout through competing terminal paths
bugs.problem: FlagService delays victory one tick without a session/generation token; timeout can mutate timing/session state first.
bugs.expected: Each attempt has exactly one terminal owner and later terminal callbacks cannot score/retry/advance it again.
bugs.observed: scoreFlag schedules endGame(victory) one tick later; timeout can run first and clear the timestamp used by the later victory guard while scheduling retry.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Other delayed retry/advance work is context-guarded; the unguarded FlagService terminal callback is the specific remaining race.
bugs.suggestedFix: Claim terminal outcome atomically per arena/session generation and bind delayed victory to that claim/context.

bugs.title: Level readiness is published while required enemy spawns can still be retrying or permanently missing
bugs.problem: Level setup can start gameplay services and report ready while configured enemies have not materialized; retry exhaustion explicitly leaves the level active.
bugs.expected: Required gameplay entities reach a terminal readiness disposition before the level becomes playable, unless a grounded degraded-mode design allows missing entities.
bugs.observed: activateLevelInside starts FlagService/ContraptionService and returns with retrying > 0; retry exhaustion logs that the level remains active.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Pending critical work is treated as readiness, allowing an incomplete configured combat population under spawn/chunk-loading failure.

relevantCode.reason: EntityLoader retry queue and activateLevelInside readiness/service start.

bugs.suggestedFix: Gate playable readiness on required enemy materialization/verification or select an explicit degraded-mode outcome.

bugs.title: Retry UI/title and chat communicate different retry information
bugs.problem: Players receive different semantic payloads for the same retry decision.
bugs.expected: Retry surfaces derive from one authoritative information model for reason, attempt and multiplier.
bugs.observed: Wipe/timeout title-subtitle surfaces expose different subsets while chat includes level, next attempt and score multiplier.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Scoring state itself is consistent; this is an information-projection defect.
bugs.suggestedFix: Build one retry presentation payload from authoritative attempt/tier state and project it consistently.

bugs.title: Lobby waiting-pad trigger is narrower than the visually communicated path
bugs.problem: The visible waiting path is wider than the fixed join AABB, so visually valid edge positions can leave the admission trigger.
bugs.expected: Join trigger covers the intended visual waiting-pad footprint without overlap with neighboring pads.
bugs.observed: Each arena uses an approximately 7x7 join AABB; leaving it immediately invokes handleAreaLeave and can remove party membership.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Source proves the trigger/leave behavior; the wider visual footprint is tester-observed evidence.
bugs.suggestedFix: Align triggers to the authored visual pad/path footprint and verify neighboring triggers remain disjoint.

bugs.title: Game-results export identifies v1.1.10 as v1.1.0
bugs.problem: Machine-readable result provenance reports the wrong artifact version.
bugs.expected: World/pack metadata and game-results export consume one canonical version and report 1.1.10.

bugs.title: Ranged Archer-family presentation still contains melee/sword state machinery despite Bow-only design
bugs.problem: Approved design is Bow-only at every distance, but ranged presentation/controller still authors swap_to_melee and melee states.
bugs.expected: Marksman/Sharpshooter remain ranged-only at all distances with no sword, melee attack or weapon-swap state.
bugs.observed: v1.1.10 spawns ranged enemies in ranged mode and no current writer to melee variant was proven, but obsolete melee/swap states remain authored.
bugs.aiAnalysis: This is design cleanup, not proof that v1.1.10 currently reaches sword combat.
bugs.suggestedFix: Remove melee/sword/swap state family for ranged enemies; keep Bow behavior at close range.

bugs.title: Attack does not implement the approved crafting-UI disablement
bugs.problem: Approved design requires crafting UI unavailable during Attack gameplay, but no crafting/inventory UI override or equivalent owner exists.
bugs.expected: Crafting UI is unavailable throughout Attack gameplay and no alternate crafting surface bypasses the restriction.
bugs.observed: Selected BP/RP contains no crafting-screen/recipe-book UI override or gameplay owner disabling that surface.
bugs.aiAnalysis: This is an approved design requirement not implemented in the selected artifact, not proof of a specific recipe exploit.

relevantCode.reason: No crafting UI override in selected RP.

bugs.suggestedFix: Implement one explicit Attack crafting-availability owner and project it through UI/capability.

bugs.title: Team flag identity is absent during Waiting and appears only when gameplay services start
bugs.problem: Approved design requires team flag visible during Waiting, but gameplay flags start with level activation.
bugs.expected: Waiting shows a non-interactive team-identity flag; capture/objective behavior activates only in gameplay.
bugs.observed: FlagService.startForArena is tied to level activation; separate display_flag_pole_red/blue entities already exist.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Display ownership can remain separate from objective ownership, avoiding pre-start capture logic.

relevantCode.reason: Gameplay FlagService starts with level activation.

bugs.suggestedFix: Manage display-only flags during Waiting and transition to gameplay objective flags at ACTIVE.
